Your factory needs a quick mind.

Mendvolt is a crisp, hands-on production-line puzzle. Read the orders, route the right parts through each machine, and make rapid repairs before the clock runs out. Every completed shift brings a new challenge, more moving pieces, and another chance to earn a perfect three-star result.

Repair the flow

Move modules, restore broken stations, and keep every conveyor working at peak efficiency.

Think under pressure

Match production orders against the line while managing time, voltage, and qualified output.

Master the factory

Progress through distinct factory areas and tackle increasingly intricate single- and dual-line layouts.

Built for the production floor.

From the first boot line to the final core system, every screen in Mendvolt is designed for clear, satisfying problem solving.
